title: Review of lab 1's autopoiesis/phase_trait (ID): individuals and division replicate on fresh seeds 3 and 4 (15 persistent splits each, generation 3 and 5, 0 merges, 22-30 bodies at t=10000 from 4 planted spots); late bodies stretch into worms
summary: Labkit packs of threads/autopoiesis/worlds/phase_trait/world.py, unchanged, 128^2, t=0-10000. From four planted catalyst spots the cells grow and divide: seed 3, 27 splits, 15 persistent, generation 3, 0 merges, 30 bodies at the end; seed 4, 20 splits, 15 persistent, generation 5, 0 merges, 22 bodies; the wall channel is membrane-like. pack/seed4/sheet.png: round cells pinch in two (t=850-4800), and from t~5000 many bodies elongate into worms and U-shapes that fill the box (occupancy 0.41).

observations.D: pack/seed4/lineage.png: 15 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges; seed 3: 15, generation 3

verdicts.limitation: Planted start (no S). I checked only I and D; the trait (heredity/selection, L7) was not examined. From t~5000 the bodies tend to worms filling the box, so individuality weakens late in the run.
